We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: picking poppy fruits (罂粟果) and planting poppy plants. This is illegal cultivation of opium poppy, which is a drug-related offense. In Chinese criminal law, cultivating poppy is "非法种植罂粟罪" under the "非法种植毒品原植物罪" (illegal cultivation of drug plants). The statutory name: "非法种植罂粟罪"? Actually the law: 《刑法》第二百四十七条之一规定非法种植罂粟或者其他毒品原植物的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。 The offense name is "非法种植罂粟罪" or "非法种植毒品原植物罪". The rule: when listing crime name(s) between tags, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "非法种植罂粟". Or maybe "非法种植罂粟" (without 罪). The instruction: "output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”." So we drop the suffix "罪". So answer: [罪名]非法种植罂粟<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: He also took poppy fruits from wild, but that is part of cultivation. No other crimes like theft. So single offense.
